svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make one. Disc 440 mm across, 12 mm S355 plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg lugs: six 110 x 85 x 10 mm plates under the disc, in three

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pairs at 120 deg, each pair 17 mm apart (inside faces) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 110 mm out from the middle, running outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21 mm hole in each, 55 mm below the disc, 110 mm out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sheave hangers: two 120 x 10 mm plates, 190 mm deep, hanging

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the leg 1 pair, 36 mm apart (inside faces), 80 mm to one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of that pair and 179 mm out from the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 26 mm axle hole in each, 125 mm below the disc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Profile cut; drill each pair together; 8 mm fillet welds.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 20 mm pin passes through each pair; the 25 mm axle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: passes both hangers; holes square to the plates.
